newsitem.title: UK: Telewest rise after Kleinwort "buy" note.
newsitem.headline: Telewest rise after Kleinwort "buy" note.

text.p: Shares in cable operator Telewest Communications Plc gained on Tuesday, after the stock was highlighted in a review of the UK telecom industry by Dresdner Kleinwort Benson, dealers said.
Shares in Telewest climbed 6p to 95p by 1409 GMT in an otherwise weak telecom sector.
Kleinwort analysts James Dodd and Paul Ryb said shares in the UK telecoms and cable sector had been oversold and worries over Telewest's financial stability had been overdone.
They added that Telewest's relationship with its four large corporate shareholders, particularly TCI and US West Media Group, will be key to the progress of Telewest shares.
